insight.title: What the world is made of when nobody is looking
insight.subtitle: The elegant architecture of the space between us.

sections.text: Look at the palms of your hands. They feel solid, heavy, and permanent. Yet, nature hides a quiet secret about the fabric of our world. Almost everything you see is made of nothing at all. If we removed the empty space from every human, our entire species would fit inside a single sugar cube.

The atoms that build your body are like miniature, silent solar systems. Each one is a vast cathedral with a tiny center. They only feel solid because invisible fields push back against your fingers. You never truly touch a lover’s hand; you simply hover near it, held apart by a microscopic, electric push.

This hidden architecture changes how we view the mundane. We are not heavy sculptures of clay, but light, intricate clouds of energy. It is a beautiful irony that the things we find most substantial are mostly made of ghosts. In a vast emptiness, the simple act of holding on is the greatest miracle of all.

news.title: Youth Congress Questions Centre on LPG Crisis and Unemployment
news.description: Youth Congress president Uday Bhanu Chib blames the Indian government's foreign policy for a deepening LPG crisis, with prices exceeding Rs 3,500 in the black market. Alleging negligence on unemployment and safety of minorities, Chib demands the revision of trade deals and ministerial accountability.
news.why: High cooking costs and job shortages strain your family's monthly budget.

news.title: Priyanka Gandhi Accuses Kerala CM of Secret Ties with BJP
news.description: Priyanka Gandhi accused the Kerala Chief Minister Pinarayi Vijayan and the ruling LDF of aligning with the BJP to remain in power, claiming both parties are compromised and corrupt. She criticized Modi's foreign policy and emphasized that the current governments in Kerala and at the center fail to ensure security and prosperity for Indians.
news.why: Political shifts can change how your local government manages public services.

news.title: India and Tajikistan Strengthen Ties in 5th Foreign Office Meet
news.description: India and Tajikistan discussed political, economic, and cultural cooperation during the 5th Foreign Office Consultations in Dushanbe. The meeting focused on strengthening bilateral relations and included interactions with the Indian community. The visit aligns with India's policy to enhance ties with Central Asian nations.
news.why: Better trade relations could make imported goods cheaper and more available.

news.title: Indian banks likely to face margin pressure amid tighter liquidity in FY27: Fitch
news.description: Indian banks may see tighter margins. The Reserve Bank of India faces challenges injecting funds due to rupee volatility. Global risks could further impact bank earnings. Despite this, Indian banks are seen as resilient. Liquidity surplus in the banking system has decreased. Rupee pressure could limit the RBI's policy options. Direct foreign currency risks for banks remain limited.
news.why: Banks may increase interest rates on your loans and credit cards.
